policies.title: Illinois standard adult minimum wage: $13.00/hr
policies.description: Effective date for the general adult rate; exceptions exist for some worker categories.

policies.title: Illinois Paid Leave for All Workers Act begins
policies.description: Covered workers generally accrue paid leave at 1 hour per 40 hours worked, up to 40 hours a year; eligibility and usage rules apply.

policies.title: Minimum wage rises to $15.00/hr
policies.description: General adult rate; remains at $15.00/hr through the October 2026 cutoff.

policies.title: Illinois job-posting pay transparency begins
policies.description: Qualifying Illinois postings from employers with at least 15 employees must disclose pay scale and benefits.

policies.title: MIT Will County living-wage update: $26.90/hr
policies.description: One adult, zero children, 2,080 hours/year. Benchmark as of February 15, 2026; NOT a historical value for prior years.

construction.title: Ruby Street bridge closure announced for July 30–August 2
construction.description: Scheduled closure of Illinois 53 bridge over Des Plaines River for aerial-tower installation; actual traffic delays not quantified.

construction.title: Cass Street bridge reduced to one lane
construction.description: IDOT announced reduction from three lanes to one due to structural steel corrosion; planned indefinitely as of the announcement.

construction.title: Downtown Chicago Street streetscape / water-main closure
construction.description: City said Chicago Street Jefferson–Cass and Clinton Street Ottawa–Scott closures would expand beginning Sept. 30 for approximately three days.

construction.title: Cass Street bridge closure for approximately two weeks
construction.description: IDOT planned downtown bridge closure beginning Dec. 13 for measurement and design work, weather permitting.

construction.title: I-80 / I-55 interchange ramp closure phase
construction.description: IDOT announced a southbound I-55 to eastbound I-80 closure anticipated until fall 2026; stage change was rescheduled.

construction.title: I-80 Joliet stage changes
construction.description: IDOT announced traffic pattern changes for I-80 from Chicago Street to Houbolt Road with overnight closures, weather permitting.

construction.title: I-80 Center Street / Meadow Avenue reconstruction closure
construction.description: IDOT forecasted reopening of ramps and bridge in late 2028; this was the announced plan, not proof of completed closure.

construction.title: I-80 / Chicago Street interchange ramps closed for major works
construction.description: Published closure/detour announcement reported ramps will remain restricted until 2028.

construction.title: I-80 / I-55 ramp changes
construction.description: IDOT announced additional ramp closures, anticipated to reopen in late fall 2026, weather permitting.

upcoming.title: Scheduled: Jackson Street bridge overnight closures through Oct 17
upcoming.description: IDOT forecasted five consecutive 7 p.m.–7 a.m. closures; cannot be treated as observed traffic history as of Oct 9.
